output.summary: The function appears to be a custom permutation function that rearranges the input data based on a seed value and then copies the rearranged data to the output buffer.

claims.text: The function uses a constant array of 8 bytes: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].
The function returns the length of the input data when the input length is less than or equal to 8.
The function returns 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF when the input length is greater than 8.
The function writes the rearranged input data to the output buffer when the input length is greater than 8.
The function does not modify the input data when the input length is less than or equal to 8.
The function contains a loop that performs a permutation of the constant array based on the seed value.
